arms.both-on: the delivering arm = the 268-B lock form

decision_rule_fixed_here: The node words and their thresholds are fixed in scripts/analysis/slurp_nxt_thinking_policy_column_read.py and in this package's README: NEEDS-THINKING, NO-RESOLVED-LOSS, GAIN (plus NOT-NEEDED-AT-THE-FLOOR) against the in-flight twin offset and the decision-190 node-column floors.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure; at most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id; run-cumulative budgets.

findings.finding: The Thinking GGUF's chat template carries an enable_thinking branch that pre-fills an empty think block, but the model card calls the checkpoint thinking-only: a no-think answer from it is out of distribution and UNMEASURED (design section 1.3). The smoke-4 cell settles whether enable_thinking false answers with no reasoning bytes and no think marker, and the read reports per arm and node the completion-token and finish-reason table, the reasoning-character and marker counts, so a no-think arm that still reasons is visible.
findings.remedy: the coordinator reads `nxt_r1_read.sh smoke` before the sign-off marker; a no-think arm that emits markers or empty answers stops the column flight.

findings.finding: Independent chains, no note sharing (coordinator ruling 2): the evidence, the instruction template and the QueryState are identical in every arm, but a non-delivering arm's Solver prompt carries THAT arm's Perception note, which a no-think Perception writes differently. The perception-off and both-off contrasts therefore measure the node together with its downstream effect on the Solver, and solver-off re-contacts Perception (a request-identical contact whose note may differ by np4 batching jitter), which the in-flight twin both-on-twin measures.
findings.remedy: none; stated so the attribution is not over-read.

findings.finding: The column carries its own A/A null, both-on-twin (a request-identical copy of the delivering both-on arm; same policy, same bytes). The 268-B cross-flight twin offset (+1.15 SLU, -0.09 intent) is the external reference, reported beside the in-flight offset and never used in a node word. The receipt schema v5 makes the twin optional, so a later budget round may fly without one.

Ruling 303 A: one experiment in flight. The P3.1 chain (SAEA-Chain-TSYSD) occupies the Thinking session; this package is DRAFT / HELD until it has finished. The session is the 268-B think-budget-np4 session (budget 3072, cap 4096, same model fragment): no per-arm session, the per-request fields carry the arm.
findings.remedy: the coordinator flips the cells only after the P3.1 chain has sealed.

findings.finding: As in the 268-B cells the model-free preflight counts the payload at 4 bytes per token (a placeholder) and would refuse the Solver render at the 4,096 cap; the cells defer to the registered exact per-contact context-fit gate (preflight_budget_mode defer-to-native-contact-fit), which runs on every arm's REAL request. A no-think arm's smaller cap (1,024) only widens its prompt limit.

scripts/checks/flight_registration_check.py's node-column findings (aa-arm-missing, variant-cost-mismatch, template-summary-mismatch) read only the Solver's template_variants block and are a no-op for a Perception-node group; the declaration is nevertheless complete (aa_arm_id, variant_cost, template_variants summary) and stage3_effect_floor_check validates its shape.
findings.remedy: widen NODE_COLUMN_PATH when the checker is next touched (not part of this package).

one_factor: the per-node thinking decoding of the non-delivering arms; the system is the 268-B Thinking lock on TRAIN Fold B
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact (TRAIN Fold B only).
No supply arm, no template column, no tool schema on any role; no Reviewer or Planner visit; max_revisions 0.

The system is the 268-B Thinking lock: the knowledge supply, the module graph, the post-processing and the roster are not changed. The per-node thinking decoding of the non-delivering arms is the ONLY varied factor.
No arm may set any knob other than enable_thinking / reasoning_budget_tokens / answer_reserve_tokens (rails.supply_variants.parse_perception_thinking_variants refuses the rest by name).
No reasoning text is ever delivered, scored or carried to another node (reasoning_context_policy drop-reasoning-v1); a delivered reasoning marker stops the flight.
No benefit claim and no admission: claims_benefit is false; the read attributes a thinking cost or gain to a node.
No flight before the coordinator countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt, the harness commit is on master, the P3.1 chain has finished and the cells are flipped.
No session is started by this registration. No paper-scale profile. No system-level claim.
the_question: Which nodes of the locked Thinking system do not need thinking (owner ruling 304)? Each non-delivering arm is read PAIRED per row against the delivering both-on arm on the same 1,080 Fold B rows in one flight, with the in-flight twin as the null.
